name: mcp.delegate
rests_on: runner.delegate spawns a detached runner.loop turn (isolated subagent). exit 0 = action ok

command.description: Declared command: spawn | status | result | list | cancel.

task.description: spawn: the task the subagent turn works on

provider.description: spawn: provider name for the subagent turn

model.description: spawn: model id override for the subagent turn

persona.description: spawn: persona id for the subagent turn

workdir.description: spawn: session working dir for the subagent (AGENTS_WORKDIR)
